name: Whole Milk
siboNotes: High lactose content can feed bacterial overgrowth in SIBO patients. Even small amounts may trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Use lactase enzyme drops to break down lactose before consuming
Heat milk gently to preserve nutritional value
Store refrigerated and use within expiration date
Consider using only in small amounts for cooking or baking
nutritionalHighlights: High in calcium for bone health
Complete protein with all essential amino acids
Rich in vitamin B12 and riboflavin
Good source of phosphorus and potassium
